name: psysfpreloc
transitions: real->protected with CS/DS/SS/ES all based at 0x00080000
description: Generic protected-mode common-base client regression. The BIOS bootstrap copies a 32-bit body to physical 0x80000, enters four 4 GiB CS/DS/SS/ES segments with that shared non-zero base, then executes a register-only arithmetic loop and relative branch before isa-debug-exit. It exercises the narrowly safe VEN_SYS_FASTPATH_RELOC guard without any Quake-specific state or protected-mode data-memory operand.
